description: Verify the production Even Android WebView exposes navigator.ml WITHOUT flags. Inventory WebNN deviceType preferences (npu/gpu/cpu), MLTensor I/O binding, Web Workers, WASM SIMD, SharedArrayBuffer and whether cross-origin isolation (COOP/COEP) can be enabled for plugin content (needed by Turso WASM), OPFS sync access handles, storage quota. Do not infer from standalone Chrome. BLOCKER if WebNN is absent. plan.md §3, §13.2.
title: Spike: WebNN and platform capability inventory in Even WebView
